subject: GCP Partner Manager Playbook & Opportunity Prioritization Lab
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Choi <alex.choi@google.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: GCP Partner Manager Playbook & Opportunity Prioritization Lab

Hi Alex / Vanessa / team,

Following up on our last co-sell sync — I'd like to run a short working session next week to do two things: (1) walk through the updated GCP Partner Manager Playbook (attached) so we have shared language for handoffs and co-sell asks, and (2) triage our joint pipeline to agree on the top 8-10 accounts to push through the marketplace co-sell channel.

Goals for the 60m session:
- Align on co-sell eligibility/prioritization criteria (SOW size, marketplace readiness, region)
- Identify immediate enablement gaps for high-opps (docs, pricing, marketplace artifacts)
- Assign next-step owners and deadlines

Proposed slots: Mon 11/30 10:00am PT, Tue 12/1 9:00am PT, Tue 12/1 2:00pm PT. Please confirm availability. I've attached the draft GCP_playbook_v2.pdf to review beforehand. Marissa — I'll ask you to bring the current opportunity list.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: GCP_playbook_v2.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB)

From: Alex Choi <alex.choi@google.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@cloudresell.io>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP Partner Manager Playbook & Opportunity Prioritization Lab

Thanks Stephanie — this is great. Happy to join the working session. Mon 11/30 10:00am PT works for me.

A couple quick notes from the GCP side ahead of the call:
- For co-sell eligibility we prioritize: validated PoC, customer procurement cadence, and marketplace readiness (images/artifacts + pricing).
- If you can flag which accounts have an active PoC or procurement lead, we can accelerate marketplace listing support (review + endorsement).

I'll loop in our Partner Engineer if we need a short readiness review. Looking forward to the playbook walk-through — will skim the PDF tonight.

Best,
Alex
Alex Choi
Partner Manager, Google Cloud
alex.choi@google.com

- Marissa: add a procurement_status column for each account and highlight PO/contract in flight (due EOD today)
